text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(It's early summer,
but there's still some snow left 
in the mountains.
The lakes can get terrifyingly cold)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(I can feel the chill. My teeth are chattering.
……but 
that's why there's meaning in enduring.
My weakness, fragility,
all of it will freeze and shatter.
And then――)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: (Building up a strong heart――!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fuu-…… ……I need to change my clothes before
my body 
gets too cold. If I catch a cold,
there would be no point.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(――……It's been about a week since I've
entered these mountains)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Placing myself in a harsh environment,
and meditating by the lake,
I can feel the effects. 
……It's okay.
I can feel myself getting stronger)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(For the 『NHK Mile Cup』,
my preparations are proceeding――)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(At the 『Hanshin Juvenile Fillies』,
honestly, 
I could tell that I was severely lacking)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Even though she let 1st place escape her,
Kraft still 
placed 3rd. On the other hand,
I didn't even place.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(But,
by the 『Fillies' Review』 I had closed 
to a distance of a head.
And at the 『Oka Sho』, 
our difference was a tenth of a second)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(I don't think there was a big difference
between our strength.
But even then I was still one step, 
just one step short.
One thing I was missing)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
……from here on out,
rather than the physical, 
this is the place for mental.
But that's why…… 
I'll push myself to the limit and train
myself……!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Until the 『NHK Mile C』, definitely……!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
――That's right,
Trainer. I want my next race to 
be the 『NHK Mile C』,
that's what I just said. ……Please.
Let me compete against Rhein Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
『Hanshin JF』『Fillies' Review』 and 『Oka
Sho』…… 
In every race, she pulled ahead of me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Kraft is the wall currently stopping me.
If I can't overcome 
her here and now,
then I won't be able to continue……!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
She has something that I don't.
To take hold of that…… 
rather than the 『Oaks』 I will choose the
『NHK Mile C』!

And so,
everyone spent April training hard……and then,
early 
May, the skies were cloudy on the day of
the 『NHK Mile Cup』.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
『Soon,
the race will begin here at the Tokyo Race
Course. 
It's unfortunate that the sky is cloudy,
but the crowd 
is still filled with tremendous
excitement!』

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
『That's because, for the Classic class,
this is the race to 
decide the "Generation's Fastest".
Where runners from the 
triple crown, tiara,
and short distance rotations gather――』

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
『To decide who stands at the pinnacle in 
terms of speed.
I'm really looking forward 
to just what kind of speed they'll show
us!』

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
『Furthermore, this time,
the Oka Sho Uma Musume, Rhein Kraft, 
is participating.
She's getting quite a bit of attention!』

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
『This is the first time in history the
Oka Sho Uma Musume has participated in the
NHK 
Mile C.
What kind of run will she show us?』

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
『Will she win against this group of young
competitors, proud of their speed,
and achieve this unorthodox double crown
for the first time in history? Now,
the NHK Mile C will soon begin!』

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
――Yes, Trainer-san. 
I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
For each of the girls participating,
I've done a lot 
of investigating and analyzing.
No matter what situations arise,
I think I can stay calm and handle them.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Get out front at the start,
take control of the pace, and 
push through with power.
I know how I should be running!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
……I'll break through. Carve a path. 
With my legs. With a run of my own.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
My dream, my apsirations, my heritage…… 
I'll connect them to the future!
